newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 8.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 29.84 points to close at 6,555.91, inspired by a drop in long-term interest rates.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index shed 2.55 points to 1,134.23, after reaching an intraday low of 1,128.35.
* Bank Negara holds news conference at 0200 GMT to explain guidelines on its property/share buying curb announced on March 28.
* Property developer Crescendo Corp makes its debut on the main board. The company offered 27.12 million shares for sale at 4.00 ringgit each.
* Malayan Banking said it has signed a memorandum of agreement to buy a 60 percent stake in PNB-Republic Bank of the Philippines for 880 million pesos.
* Tamadam Bonded Warehouse said it had revised the ratio and price of its rights issue from two-for-five to one-for-two and the price from 4.00 ringgit to 4.35 ringgit.
